# Diligence Checklist Template

## How to use

This is the firm's master diligence checklist. It covers the six
standard threads for a stand-alone target acquisition. For carve-out
deals, supplement with the carve-out playbook's eight additional
threads.

Each section is structured as a list of required information requests
(IR), with the purpose of each request, the typical document type
that satisfies it, and the red flag that should escalate the finding
to a deal-team review.

## Financial due diligence

### Quality of earnings

- [ ] **IR-F-01.** Last 3 years audited financial statements + most
  recent management accounts.
  - Purpose: confirm reported topline + margin trajectory.
  - Red flag: revenue recognition policy changes; one-time gains
    >5% of reported EBITDA.
- [ ] **IR-F-02.** Revenue by customer (top 30 customers, last 12 months).
  - Purpose: assess concentration risk + churn signals.
  - Red flag: top 3 >50% of revenue; year-on-year decline in any top
    10 account >25%.
- [ ] **IR-F-03.** Revenue by product / segment (full granularity).
  - Purpose: identify hidden segment-level decline masked by mix.
  - Red flag: a previously material segment now <half its 3-year-ago size.
- [ ] **IR-F-04.** EBITDA bridge (reported → adjusted) with each
  adjustment documented.
  - Purpose: validate adjusted EBITDA the seller will quote.
  - Red flag: any single normalising adjustment >15% of reported EBITDA.

### Working capital and cash

- [ ] **IR-F-05.** Monthly working capital movement over 36 months.
  - Purpose: identify seasonality + working-capital absorption risk.
  - Red flag: Q1 cash compression >20%; persistent debtor build-up.
- [ ] **IR-F-06.** Aged debtor + creditor analysis at latest month.
  - Purpose: pre-flag bad-debt risk + supplier-relations risk.
  - Red flag: >10% of debtors past 90 days; supplier stretch >120 days.
- [ ] **IR-F-07.** Capex history + forward capex plan.
  - Purpose: assess sustainable cash conversion.
  - Red flag: capex <50% of depreciation over a sustained period
    (asset under-investment).

### Debt and leverage

- [ ] **IR-F-08.** Full debt schedule (facility, amount, rate,
  maturity, covenants, security).
  - Purpose: structure deal capital + check change-of-control clauses.
  - Red flag: covenant headroom <15%; any change-of-control trigger
    that's not pre-agreed.

## Commercial due diligence

### Market position

- [ ] **IR-C-01.** Independent market sizing (TAM/SAM/SOM) with
  source methodology.
  - Red flag: SOM claim >5% in <3 years without retailer commitments.
- [ ] **IR-C-02.** Competitor mapping (top 5 by share + key emerging
  entrants).
  - Red flag: missing a credible competitor; understated competitive
    intensity.
- [ ] **IR-C-03.** Win/loss analysis for last 100 enterprise deals
  (won + lost).
  - Red flag: high loss rate to a single emerging competitor.

### Customer dynamics

- [ ] **IR-C-04.** Customer reference call list (10-15 customers
  spanning size + sector).
  - Red flag: refusal or inability to provide references in any
    important segment.
- [ ] **IR-C-05.** Net Promoter Score / customer satisfaction trend
  over 24 months.
  - Red flag: NPS decline >10 points; CSAT score below 4.0/5.
- [ ] **IR-C-06.** Customer churn analysis (logo + revenue retention,
  cohort-segmented).
  - Red flag: gross logo churn >15% in a B2B SaaS context.

## Operational due diligence

- [ ] **IR-O-01.** Organisation chart with tenure + key-person flags.
  - Red flag: critical role with <12 months tenure or no successor
    identified.
- [ ] **IR-O-02.** Technology stack overview + integration map.
  - Red flag: single point of failure on a legacy system; >50% custom
    code.
- [ ] **IR-O-03.** Vendor concentration (top 10 suppliers with terms).
  - Red flag: top supplier >25% of cost base.
- [ ] **IR-O-04.** Process maps for revenue + cost cycles.
  - Red flag: heavy manual reconciliation steps; control gaps at
    cycle boundaries.

## Synergy quantification

- [ ] **IR-S-01.** Revenue synergy hypotheses with quantified upside
  + assumed timing.
  - Red flag: total revenue synergies >20% of target revenue
    (over-claim signature).
- [ ] **IR-S-02.** Cost synergy hypotheses with realisation timing +
  one-off cost-to-achieve.
  - Red flag: timing assumptions ignore integration drag in year 1.
- [ ] **IR-S-03.** Dis-synergies (revenue loss + cost step-up from
  the transaction itself).
  - Red flag: dis-synergy estimate is zero (always present some).

## Valuation triangulation

- [ ] **IR-V-01.** DCF model with explicit WACC build + terminal value
  approach (Gordon Growth + exit multiple).
  - Red flag: terminal value >70% of enterprise value (over-reliance
    on perpetuity).
- [ ] **IR-V-02.** Comparable trading companies (5-10 names with
  multiples).
  - Red flag: peer set is selective (excludes credible direct
    competitors).
- [ ] **IR-V-03.** Comparable transactions (5-10 deals, last 36
  months).
  - Red flag: each transaction's deal-specific context not surfaced.

## Integration risk

- [ ] **IR-I-01.** Day-1 readiness assessment (what must work; what
  can wait).
  - Red flag: customer-facing critical systems on Day-1 list with
    no clear owner.
- [ ] **IR-I-02.** 100-day integration plan (workstreams, leaders,
  milestones).
  - Red flag: missing functional workstream; no executive sponsor.
- [ ] **IR-I-03.** Communication plan for customers, employees, and
  market.
  - Red flag: no plan for the "key customer phone calls" that need
    to happen Day 1.

the deal book is updated.
